Nepal · Emergency appeal

Emergency Relief for Nepal

The recent disaster in Nepal has severely affected communities in the Rasuwa region, leaving many families urgently in need of food, blankets, cooking supplies, emergency solar power, and other basic necessities.

Give now
What happened

Standing with the people of Rasuwa

Paititi Institute is organizing this emergency fundraising campaign in direct coordination with Lama Karma Tsultrim Sangpo and the Manang Society Monastery.

Lama Karma served as a close assistant to the late Lama Sherab Gyaltsen Rinpoche, whose guidance and vision helped inspire the establishment of Paititi Institute in 2010. Through these long-standing relationships within our Kagyu lineage, we are able to direct assistance toward the elders, women, children, and families facing the greatest hardship in the affected areas.

Working through trusted local relationships will allow assistance to reach the people who need it with fewer administrative delays. We will share updates about the relief effort, the supplies purchased, and their distribution as the work progresses.

Campaign open

Give to families in Rasuwa

Your gift buys food, blankets, cooking equipment and emergency solar power, and reaches families in the Rasuwa region through Lama Karma Tsultrim Sangpo and the Manang Society Monastery.

Zeffy charges no platform fees, so your offering moves directly into the relief effort. Paititi Institute is registered in Peru and fiscally sponsored in the United States by Empowerment WORKS, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, so donations through Zeffy are tax-deductible in the United States.

Where the money goes

What your gift buys

Funds raised through this campaign will be used to purchase and distribute essential supplies according to the immediate needs identified locally, including:

  • Food and basic necessities
  • Blankets and warm materials
  • Cooking equipment and household supplies
  • Solar panels and other sources of emergency electricity
  • Additional essential relief materials requested by affected communities

Every contribution, regardless of its size, will help provide practical support to families living through this crisis. Thank you for standing with the people of Rasuwa during this difficult time, and for helping us extend this circle of compassion and reciprocity across cultures and continents.

The region we walk through

Rasuwa is the district of the Langtang Himal — the same valleys our Himalayan Pilgrimage travels through with the Karuna Project in October 2026. The families this appeal supports are the communities that host that journey.
